data.name: Du’aabaqat
data.gender_notes: Du’aabaqat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who constantly makes supplication and seeks Allah's help and guidance. The name Du’aabaqat carries the meaning “One who makes Du'a' (supplication)” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Du’aabaqat usually hope their child will grow to embody one who makes du'a' (supplication) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages a deep connection with Allah and a constant state of prayer and supplication.
data.etymology: Du’aabaqat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who makes Du'a' (supplication).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Du’aabaqat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: دُعَاءَبَقَات
in_arabic.meaning: المقصود به العُلاوة و المَجد و الصِحابة
in_arabic.long_meaning: دُعَاءَبَقَات: الاسم العَربي من أصل دُعاء، يُرمز إلى العُلاوة و المَجد و الصِحابة، و هو إسم مشتق من الأَصل اليَميني، و يُستخدم في العادة لِلمولودين الذكور، و يَرمز إلى حَماس و طَماعَة و رغبة في الحُصول على المَجد و العُلاوة، و هو من أسماء الأَصليين في الإسلام، و يُشير إلى الصِحابة و الرُسُل أَيضاً.

The term "Du’aabaqat" signifies an individual who is deeply committed to this practice of constant supplication, helping to cultivate a society that values seeking Allah's mercy and help in times of need.

By consistently making supplications, an individual is acknowledging Allah's omnipotence and is seeking His guidance, protection, and mercy. It is a powerful reminder of the importance of communication with Allah and the humility that comes with recognizing our need for His help. Through this practice, an individual can develop a deeper connection with Allah and experience a greater sense of peace, contentment, and guidance in their life.
